pairs.gold_text: Injuries were confirmed and documented in Nerridge during the collapse response.
pairs.system_text: Injuries were confirmed in Nerridge in the first statements after the collapse, without a count being given.

pairs.gold_text: Nerridge fire service reported rescuing nine people during the initial response to the Aldan House collapse.
pairs.system_text: Nerridge fire service rescued nine people from the collapsed building in the first hours of the response.

pairs.gold_text: The collapse destroyed Aldan House and its east wing.
pairs.system_text: Aldan House and its east wing on Cobbett Row were destroyed in the collapse.

pairs.gold_text: Service at Aldan House was reported disrupted.
pairs.system_text: Service at Aldan House was disrupted by the collapse.

pairs.gold_text: Provincial Urban Search and Rescue deployed during the collapse response.
pairs.system_text: Provincial Urban Search and Rescue deployed to Cobbett Row within two hours of the collapse.
